newsitem.title: MACAU: China's President Jiang to visit Portugal.
newsitem.headline: China's President Jiang to visit Portugal.

text.p: Chinese President Jiang Zemin has accepted Portugal's invitation to visit the country at a date yet to be arranged, Portuguese President Jorge Sampaio told reporters accompanying him on a visit to China.

Jiang accepted the invitation "with great pleasure" during talks this week in Beijing, Sampaio said late on Wednesday while visiting the northeastern city of Shenyang, reporters from the Portuguese-ruled enclave of Macau said.

The Portuguese president is on an eight-day state visit to China. Macau is the main foreign policy issue between the two countries as the enclave is due to revert to China in 1999, two years after Britain hands back neighbouring Hong Kong.
Jiang stopped in Portugal for one day in November 1993 on a flight from Brazil to China.
Sampaio is scheduled to visit Xian and Shanghai before he returns to Lisbon on Sunday.
